config.script:
client = system.net.httpClient()
	hostname = self.view.params.IP
	port = self.view.params.port
	apiToken = self.view.params.API_KEY
	device = self.view.params.deviceData.Name

	headers = {
		"Content-Type": "application/json",
		"X-Ignition-API-Token": apiToken,
	}	
	newDeviceConfig = {}
	getUrl = "http://{}:{}/data/api/v1/resources/find/com.inductiveautomation.opcua/device/{}".format(hostname,port,device)
	putUrl = "http://{}:{}/data/api/v1/resources/com.inductiveautomation.opcua/device".format(hostname,port)
	response = client.get(getUrl, headers=headers)
	
	newDeviceConfig = response.json
	
	newDeviceConfig['description'] = self.view.params.deviceData.Description if event.get('Description') == "" else event.get('Description')
	newDeviceConfig['config']['settings']['connectivity']['hostname'] = self.view.params.deviceData.Hostname if event.get('Hostname') == "" else event.get('Hostname')
	newDeviceConfig['config']['settings']['connectivity']['port'] = str(self.view.params.deviceData.Port if event.get('Port') == "" else event.get('Port'))
	newDeviceConfig['config']['settings']['requestOptimization']['spanGaps'] = self.view.params.deviceData.SpanGaps if event.get('SpanGaps') == "" else event.get('SpanGaps')
	newDeviceConfig['config']['settings']['advanced']['reverseWordOrder'] = self.view.params.deviceData.ReverseWordOrder if event.get('ReverseWordOrder') == "" else event.get('ReverseWordOrder')
	newDeviceConfig['config']['settings']['advanced']['zeroBasedAddressing'] = self.view.params.deviceData.ZeroBasedAddressing if event.get('ZeroBasedAddressing') == "" else event.get('ZeroBasedAddressing')

	response2 = client.put(putUrl, headers=headers, data=[newDeviceConfig])
	
	self.view.custom.apiResponse = str(response2) + str(response2.json)
	system.perspective.closePopup("editDevicePopup")
